name: Scoundrel's Cutlass

effects.name: Enhancement Bonus
effects.tooltip: +2 Enhancement Bonus : +2 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls .

effects.name: Frost
effects.tooltip: Frost : This weapon is sheathed in icy cold. A frost weapon deals an extra 1 to 6 points of cold damage on a successful hit.

effects.name: Anarchic
effects.tooltip: Anarchic : An anarchic weapon is chaotically aligned and infused with the power of chaos. It makes the weapon chaos-aligned and thus bypasses the corresponding damage reduction. It deals an extra 2 to 12 damage against all of lawful alignment.

flavor_text: A pirate classic. Great for a ship-to-ship boarding action. Plus, it makes you look positively frightening when you wave it around at people.
tips: The Pirate Treasure Map , the 3 items from the Corsair's Cunning set, the 4 'scoundrel type' weapons and Brine Shaman's Staff have a chance of appearing in the end reward list of any of the Three-Barrel Cove (heroic) quests, except Guard Duty . Every third completion you will receive a complete list.
